name: In The Last Days
overview: Scripture reveals that the last days will be marked by increased knowledge and activity, as Daniel 12:4 describes a time when many will 'run to and fro' and knowledge will grow. The outpouring of God's Spirit will bring prophetic dreams and visions across all ages, fulfilling Joel 2:28. Jesus emphasizes the urgency of readiness and accountability, warning that every word spoken will be judged (Matthew 12:36) and urging vigilance since the timing of His return is unknown (Matthew 24:42). The gospel will be proclaimed worldwide as a final witness before the end comes (Matthew 24:14), highlighting the global significance of these last days.
